title: Probabilistic Meshless Methods on Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2610.39855v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Probabilistic meshless methods solve partial differential equations (PDEs) by placing a Gaussian process prior on the solution and conditioning it on the PDE at a finite set of collocation nodes. The posterior provides both an approximation of the solution and a Bayesian quantification of its error. While these methods are well established on Euclidean domains, their extension to manifolds lacks, to our knowledge, any convergence analysis. We extend them to compact manifolds and study their convergence in two settings. First, for known manifolds whose Laplace-Beltrami eigenpairs are available, the prior can be evaluated exactly, but the PDE operator generally cannot be applied to it in closed form. translated_title: 流形上的概率无网格方法
translated_abstract: 概率无网格方法通过在解上放置高斯过程先验，并在有限个配点节点处以偏微分方程（PDE）为条件对其进行调节，从而求解偏微分方程。后验分布既提供了解的近似，也提供了对其误差的贝叶斯量化。虽然这些方法在欧氏区域上已经发展成熟，但据我们所知，其在流形上的扩展尚缺乏任何收敛性分析。我们将这些方法扩展到紧流形上，并在两种设定下研究其收敛性。首先，对于拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米特征对已知的流形，先验可以被精确计算，但PDE算子通常无法以闭式形式作用于其上。我们用在从流形上采样的点云上进行标准广义有限差分离散化来替代该算子，并证明所得方法在点云的各点上是一致的，其收敛速率由点云的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将概率无网格方法首次扩展到紧流形并给出其收敛性分析，在拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米特征对已知的情形下，采用点云上的广义有限差分离散化PDE算子并证明方法在采样点处的一致收敛性。
en_tdlr: The paper extends probabilistic meshless methods to compact manifolds with the first convergence analysis, showing that replacing the PDE operator with a generalized finite difference discretization on a sampled point cloud yields consistency at the cloud points when Laplace-Beltrami eigenpairs are known.
